function.description: Deploy a fixed-supply token AND create and seed its Uniswap v4 pool against quote_token, in one act. The owner's act (card, owner turn, or a mandate naming it); the launch.* limits bind. Read the token-launch skill first. dry_run defaults TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_launch_token

chain.description: Chain to launch on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas and per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

dry_run.description: TRUE (default) checks and simulates the deploy; false runs every step.

initial_price.description: The starting price: quote tokens per ONE new token.

max_spend_usd.description: The most USD at risk: the seed at the launch price plus fees.

quote_amount.description: Whole units of the quote token seeded; 0 = one-sided (a range above the price).

quote_token.description: The pool's other token (an address; the zero address = native). launch.pair, if pinned, decides it.

range.description: full, low,high (quote per token) or ticks:lo,hi.

supply.description: Whole units, all minted to the wallet.

token_amount.description: Whole units of the new token seeded.

why.description: Why this act, now (one line). Required on an autonomous run; the owner reads it.
